query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.perfil, u.ativo, u.tenantId, u.lastSignedIn,
       t.nome as tenantNome,
       GROUP_CONCAT(ue.empresaSlug ORDER BY ue.empresaSlug SEPARATOR ', ') as empresasVinculadas
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON u.tenantId = t.id
LEFT JOIN userEmpresas ue ON ue.userId = u.id AND ue.tenantId = u.tenantId
WHERE u.ativo = 1
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.perfil, u.ativo, u.tenantId, u.lastSignedIn, t.nome
ORDER BY t.nome, u.name;
